d: Orange County Choppers takes on an extraordinary custom motorcycle project for seven-time Tour de France champion Lance Armstrong and the LIVESTRONG Foundation. After meeting Lance in Austin, Paul Sr., Paul Jr. and Mikey draw inspiration from high-performance racing bicycles to create a sleek, lightweight chopper. With carbon fiber accents, custom bicycle-inspired details and the iconic yellow-and-black color scheme, this build demands a fresh approach to motorcycle fabrication. Watch the OCC crew bring cycling inspiration and custom motorcycle craftsmanship together in American Chopper,…
